justification: GST-3364 (Codex CLI 0.170 refuses rm with a force flag): review/sections/adversarial.md, ship/sections/adversarial.md and ship/sections/review-army.md change only shell cleanup that no reviewer reads. The outside-voice runner's EXIT trap becomes trap 'rm -r "$_OUTSIDE_TMP"' EXIT instead of rm -rf, and Step 9's entry command clears .gstack/tmp/targeted.json with { rm .gstack/tmp/targeted.json 2>/dev/null || true; } instead of rm -f. The prompt each voice receives comes from its prompt file, not from the trap line. Deterministic no-loss check, no paid run: every brief body lib/review-brief.ts cuts from the ship sections keeps its pinned hash (test/fixtures/review-pins/brief-bodies unchanged; test/review-packets-removed.test.ts 'every reviewer brief cut from the ship sections is byte-identical to its pinned body' passes at this tree). No reader, depth, dispatch, brief, checklist or finding rule changes; CREW rule 15 exempts non-reviewer /ship prose.
